Mightyena

Dark

Hoenn · Generation 3

Mightyena is a Dark-type Bite Pokémon first found in Hoenn (Generation 3). It stands 1 m tall and weighs 37 kg. It evolves from Poochyena. Its highest base stat is Attack (90), with a base stat total of 420.
